decision.reason: Import cold task improves, but whole CPU is effectively flat and facing-zoom P99 regresses in the formal six; insufficient whole-workflow evidence to retain under the fixed-quality/fluency requirement.

decision.energy: Uncalibrated CPU demand only; no watts, joules or battery-life claim.
